propositions: When completion verification fails due to evidence search exhaustion without refuting any criterion, the gate should automatically re-run the verification instead of surfacing a failure to the operator.
Auto-resume qualification uses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to detect insufficiency-only failures, where all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker.
The resumption loop wraps the shared close-gate seam at close_precheck._completion_precheck:638 (llm.verify_completion call), so CLI, MCP, and library closes all flow through it.

Auto-resumption is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max count (default 2, disabled at 0) and by progress: a resumption only dispatches when the prior attempt strictly increased cache-credited PASS count.
